caption: The drawing depicts a single glass vase rendered predominantly in shades of blue. The vase has a wide, circular base that curves upward into a slender, elongated neck, which is straight with a slight outward flare at the rim. The body of the vase features a spiral pattern, suggesting a twisted or spiral-blown glass design. Wrapping around the neck of the vase, from the bottom towards the top, is a decorative band composed of small, textured shapes that may resemble a garland or a series of glass knobs fused to the surface. The background is plain and uncolored, and there is a signature in the lower right portion of the image. The entire composition is centered on the page with ample empty space surrounding the object.
title: Vase
